rank_comparison.rule: Normalize each rank to a list-length-aware percentile before comparing rankings.
rank_comparison.reason: The rankings can contain different list lengths, player pools and expert panels.

redraft-ppr-superflex.interpretation: Current-season lineup, production and win-now context.

win_now_gap.definition: redraft_percentile minus dynasty_percentile on a scale where a higher percentile is better
win_now_gap.positive_interpretation: Redraft is relatively stronger than Dynasty; possible win-now producer or veteran discount.
win_now_gap.negative_interpretation: Dynasty is relatively stronger than Redraft; future asset value may exceed current-season expectation.

limitations: Prefer snapshots fetched on the same day.
FantasyPros may use different expert panels or list depths across ranking types.
Redraft ECR is not a projection and not Dynasty trade value.
Dynasty ECR is not a current-season Start/Sit ranking.
Apply Mighty Giants league scarcity, roster, salary, ownership, injury and news context after comparison.
